blocks.heading: The virtual world fund
blocks.subtitle: 100T EGG set aside for teams building virtual worlds.
blocks.body: Phisum puts EGG, the Phiegg world's token, into small teams that build worlds people can walk into: cities, venues, games and the agents that live in them. Teams build together in twelve-week cohorts on Phipad and show their worlds at Demo Day.

blocks.lead: EGG is the token of the Phiegg world, made for use inside it. Nothing on this site is an offer of securities or investment advice, and no return is promised. The terms of each cohort are set by the fund and published before it opens.

programme.title: The programme
programme.sub: A fund for the people who build virtual worlds, paid in the token of the world they build in.

blocks.lead: Phisum sets aside 100 trillion EGG for teams. It is spent cohort by cohort: each cohort gets its share, and each team in it an allocation released in stages as it builds.

sections.title: Who it is for
sections.body: Small teams, from one founder up, building a world people can enter: a city, a venue, a game, a shop, a show, or the agents that live in any of them. An idea with a prototype is enough; a world already live is welcome too.

sections.title: Phisum and Phipad
sections.body: Phisum is the fund: it holds the EGG and sets the terms. Phipad is the accelerator: it takes the applications, runs the cohorts and holds Demo Day. A team applies once, on Phipad.

sections.title: Four tracks
sections.body: Virtual worlds, agentic worlds, AR, and avatars and identity. Each track has its own mentors; Phipad sets them out.

sections.title: EGG on NEAR
sections.body: EGG is planned as a fungible token on NEAR. Until its contract is live, an allocation is a record kept by the fund; once it is live, EGG goes to the team's NEAR account.

support.sub: Everything a cohort has, for every team in it.

terms.title: Terms
terms.sub: Set by the fund, published per cohort. Until they are published, nothing here is an offer.

sections.title: What each cohort's terms set out
sections.body: The size of a team's EGG allocation, the stages it is released in and what unlocks each one, what the fund asks of a team in return if anything, and the dates. They are the same for every team in a cohort.

sections.title: Where they stand
sections.body: The terms for the first cohort are being written. They will be published on Phipad before applications for it close.

sections.title: What EGG is
sections.body: EGG is the token of the Phiegg world, used inside it: to enter, to make, to host and to vote. It is not offered as an investment, carries no promise of a return, and may have no value outside the world.

sections.title: No advice
sections.body: Nothing on this site is legal, tax or investment advice. Teams should take their own advice before accepting any terms.

token.title: EGG on NEAR
token.sub: EGG is planned as a fungible token on NEAR. Connect a NEAR wallet here; the balance shows once the contract is live.

sections.title: Why NEAR
sections.body: Readable account names (yourname.near), wallets that work in the browser, and transfers that settle in a few seconds for a small fee.

sections.title: What connecting does
sections.body: It reads which account is yours. It sends nothing, signs nothing and adds no key. Teams give the same account on their Phipad application, so EGG has somewhere to go once it is live.

blocks.heading: Apply on Phipad
blocks.subtitle: One application, read every week.
blocks.body: Phipad runs Phisum's cohorts, so applications go there: the team, the world, a link to see it and a short video. It is free.

faq.title: FAQ
faq.sub: About the fund and EGG. Questions about cohorts are answered on Phipad.

items.a: A fund for teams building virtual worlds. It sets aside 100 trillion EGG, the Phiegg world's token, and puts it into teams cohort by cohort.

items.q: How much EGG does a team get?
items.a: It is set per cohort and published with that cohort's terms, before applications close. Every team in a cohort gets the same terms.

items.q: What does the fund take in return?
items.a: That is set in each cohort's published terms. Read them, and take your own advice, before accepting.
No. EGG is the token of the Phiegg world, made for use inside it. It is not offered as an investment, no return is promised, and it may have no value outside the world.
Readable account names, wallets that work in a browser, and quick, cheap transfers. EGG is planned as a NEAR token under the NEP-141 standard.
Not yet. Until the contract is live, a team's allocation is a record kept by the fund.

items.q: Do I need a NEAR wallet to apply?
items.a: No. You can add a NEAR account to your application later; it is where EGG goes once the token is live.
Any team, from one founder up, building a world people can enter. Apply on Phipad.

items.q: How do Phisum and Phipad fit together?
items.a: Phisum is the fund and sets the terms. Phipad is the accelerator: applications, cohorts and Demo Day.
